version.changelog: v5.1.3 — simplifies waitlist language and aligns copy with live outbound mail, existing-address inbound context, current pricing, and the real mailing mailbox address waitlist.

llm.summary: The skill matches its postal-mail purpose, but it needs user review because it can expose sensitive mail content and let agents trigger real-world or destructive mail actions.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is coherent: outbound physical mail, inbound forwarded document context, postal threads, and private-beta mailbox handling. The concern is that these capabilities include sensitive OCR/document access, paid mail sending, and private-beta actions such as shred, dispose, and return to sender.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The artifacts disclose approval mechanisms, sandbox keys, cost caps, and explicit operator consent for signup, but also describe MAILBOX.md rules where actions fire automatically and examples where junk mail is discarded without a default human confirmation requirement.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Installation is a remote MCP/API configuration using bearer authentication; there is no bundled executable code or hidden local install. The optional command bridge uses npx mcp-remote to connect to the same remote server.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Connecting this skill to an autonomous agent is high impact because the remote service may process private legal, financial, business, or personal mail and can send physical mail or change mailbox handling state.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill requires API keys, distinguishes member, agent, and sandbox keys, and documents persistent notes/tags/metadata. Agent-scoped keys and force-approval policies reduce risk, but users must avoid full member keys unless needed.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable giving an agent access to postal-mail workflows and document context. Use sandbox keys first, prefer agent-scoped keys over full member keys, enable force approval for mail sending and mailbox actions, set cost caps, and require human review before discarding, shredding, disposing, returning, or forwarding any physical mail.
llm.findings:
[suspicious.exposed_secret_literal] expected: The flagged value appears to be a placeholder example, not a real exposed secret. Requiring bearer API keys is expected for this service.
[SQP-2] expected: Handling sensitive inbound mail, OCR context, and mailbox actions is expected for the stated purpose and is disclosed, but the artifacts do not consistently require human approval before automatic discard or destructive private-beta actions.
